interactivity.midnightconfig.title: Interactivity
interactivity.midnightconfig.maxCoresAmo: The maximum number of CPU cores to use for physics simulation per world. If more than available cores, uses all available cores. Default to maximum available cores.
interactivity.midnightconfig.networkTran: Priorities for default networking transports. TCP (Minecraft Networking) can always be used, so if you want to disable other transports, make their priority lower than TCP.
interactivity.midnightconfig.udpPort.too:
-1 — Use Minecraft server port
0 — Disable UDP transport
interactivity.midnightconfig.uselessDevO: This option does nothing useful: turn it on and try to find out what it does!
